'''''Lords of the Sith''''' is a [[canon]] novel written by [[Paul S. Kemp]]. It was published on [[April 28]], [[2015]] by [[Del Rey]]. The story is set in the [[Standard year|year]] [[14 BBY]], and it connects with stories from the television shows ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' and ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. The [[Lords of the Sith (audiobook)|audiobook version]] was narrated by [[Jonathan Davis]].
